Your Journey

From first consultation to lasting results

A proven 4-phase system that transforms how you eat, feel, and live

01
Week 1

Discovery & Assessment

Deep-dive consultation covering health history, lifestyle habits, food preferences, and goals. InBody scan reveals your starting composition.

What you get:

  • 60-minute initial consultation
  • Full body composition analysis
  • Personalized nutrition roadmap
  • Nutrium app access & training
02
Weeks 2-4

Foundation Building

Establish core eating patterns, portion strategies, and meal timing. Learn to navigate real-world situations while tracking progress.

What you get:

  • Weekly 30-40min follow-ups
  • Meal framework customization
  • Progress photos & measurements
  • Direct app messaging support
03
Weeks 5-12

Optimization & Refinement

Fine-tune your approach based on results. Address plateaus, adjust for lifestyle changes, introduce advanced strategies.

What you get:

  • Bi-weekly optimization sessions
  • Advanced nutrition techniques
  • Habit troubleshooting
  • Social eating mastery
04
Month 4+

Independence & Maintenance

Transition to self-management with confidence. Quarterly check-ins ensure you stay on track long-term.

What you get:

  • Maintenance protocol creation
  • Relapse prevention strategies
  • Lifetime app access
  • Quarterly tune-up sessions

Our Commitment

If you follow the plan and don't see measurable progress in 8 weeks, we'll work with you for free until you do.

The Diaeta Manifesto

01

Food is Not the Enemy

Common Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

Quick answers to common questions about consultations, programs, and reimbursement.

Do I need a doctor's referral?
No referral required in Belgium. We can coordinate with your GP when helpful.
Are consultations reimbursed?
Many Belgian mutual health funds offer €10-25 partial reimbursement. We provide compliant receipts.
How long are sessions?
First consultation: 60 minutes. Follow-ups: 30-40 minutes.
Do you offer video consultations?
Yes! Secure video appointments available for all programs.
Which conditions do you treat?
IBS (Low-FODMAP), weight management, Type 2 diabetes, cholesterol/hypertension.
What should I bring?
Recent labs, medication list, 3-day food diary (optional but helpful).

Still have questions?

We're here to help you understand every aspect of your nutrition journey.
